procedure: Copy this file to docs/reports/D103-halts.json only after live collection ends (T0 + 7d).
checked_at: UTC ISO-8601 time the announcements were last checked. Left empty, load_halts rejects the file, so statistics cannot run on an unfilled template.
halts: symbol -> list of {start, end, source}. start/end are epoch milliseconds UTC, end exclusive, start < end. source is the announcement URL (required).
Include only allowlist symbols and only announced trading suspensions (splits, delistings, maintenance). Do not add intervals inferred from prices or gaps in the data.
No suspensions found: keep halts as {} and still fill checked_at.
List every announcement source checked, including ones with no suspension, in sources_checked.
